Optimal.Notes: Native resolution at 60 fps is easily achievable for this 2D indie title; 7 W TDP leaves headroom without unnecessary drain. This is the recommended everyday profile for most players.

profiles.Summary: Cult of the Lamb is a lightweight 2D indie roguelite with minimal GPU demands, running well within the Steam Deck's capabilities and earning a Verified status with a strong platinum ProtonDB rating. Expect smooth 60 fps performance even at low TDP, making it an excellent handheld title with long battery life.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's very modest PC minimum requirements (GTX 560 Ti class) and its 2D indie nature. On your first run, confirm the frame counter stays at 60 fps in the busiest cult-building areas and adjust TDP down if battery drain seems high.

MaxBattery.Notes: Extremely conservative profile for maximum session length; the game is 2D-heavy and barely stresses the APU, so even 4 W TDP is comfortable at 30 fps. Bump to Optimal if you want a smoother feel.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Uncapped with all limits removed; the game's 2D art style means the Deck GPU is barely loaded even at max settings, so there is no meaningful visual upgrade over Optimal — this profile is for players who simply want zero restrictions. Battery life drops due to the unconstrained APU.

Optimal.Notes: Native 1280x800 at 60 fps is very comfortable for this 2D title; 7 W TDP is more than sufficient to hold the cap with headroom to spare. This is the sweet spot for visual quality and battery life.

profiles.Summary: Cult of the Lamb is a lightweight 2D indie roguelite that runs excellently on the Steam Deck, well within the hardware's capabilities thanks to its modest PC requirements and Unity engine. The game is Steam Deck Verified with full controller support, and ProtonDB reporters at platinum tier confirm it runs smoothly out of the box.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Deck tuning reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's very modest PC requirements (GTX 560 Ti minimum), its 2D Unity art style, and the Deck's hardware capabilities. On your first run, verify that the in-game graphics menu matches the option names used here, as Unity games can vary; the game should handle 60–90 fps with ease given its lightweight nature.

MaxBattery.Notes: At 4 W TDP with a low GPU clock, the game holds a rock-solid 30 fps with ease; FSR upscaling from 960x600 keeps visuals acceptable. This profile prioritises maximum session length for handheld play away from power.

MaxPerformance.Notes: The game's lightweight engine can sustain 90 fps on the OLED's highest refresh rate, making combat and animations feel noticeably snappier; the trade-off is significantly reduced battery life. Drop to 60 Hz if you need more than ~2 hours.
